blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The United States (US) wants to strengthen its economic partnership with the Philippines to match their long-standing defense alliance, US Ambassador to the Philippines Lee Lipton said on Monday. In a statement, Lipton said Washington supports the Philippines’ economic development and believes that stronger economic cooperation should complement the two countries’ security partnership. “We also believe our security partnership must be matched by an equally strong economic partnership,” he said. “The United States supports the Philippines’ economic development and believes reciprocal, mutually beneficial trade is essential to shared prosperity,” he added.
